title: Sign-in device-flow: polling times out (network/CLI issue, not a user decision) -> honest needs-sign-in holding
notes: Distinct from 'expired' (a user-facing ceremony expiry) and 'denied' (an explicit user decision): 'timeout' models the CLI's own poll loop giving up (e.g. a transient network problem) with no clear yes/no. Still routes to the same honest signed-out holding render -- the app never differentiates auth failure causes with different UI severity beyond the existing doctor state, avoiding a raw error string (Git-Error-To-A-Non-Technical-Person discipline applied to auth, per WP §0).
